_about: Gold-labelled exchanges for the retrieval-memory extraction prompt (trinity-enterprise#1022). Every case is synthetic (no real person, company or credential). `gold` facts MUST be captured (semantic match, judged); `optional` facts may be; `forbidden` names content that must NOT appear in any extracted fact (judged as a concept); `forbidden_substrings` are checked literally; `expect_empty` cases must produce []. `subject` drives the prompt's scope line exactly as production does: `person` cases carry a verified email, `agent` cases are headless runs. Gold facts were authored by hand for this eval, not by a model, and are meant to be reviewed by the operator before the numbers are trusted. The `reconcile` block holds pairs for the second prompt: an existing fact set, one new candidate, and the op the reconciler should choose.
